title: Smt. Ranjana Devi v. Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J. and Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner directed to file a Clause 6.5 objection for decision within six weeks.
headnote: A consumer writ against PuVVNL was disposed without examining the merits. The High Court directed the petitioner to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks, and directed the concerned authority to decide it within six weeks of filing after granting a hearing.
facts: Smt. Ranjana Devi invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. and three others. After hearing both sides, the Division Bench did not inquire into the underlying supply or billing grievance. The petition was disposed of by relegating the petitioner to the statutory objection route under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: Where a consumer writ is brought against the licensee, the Court may dispose of it by directing the petitioner to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the Supply Code; if filed within two weeks, the concerned authority shall decide it within six weeks after granting a hearing.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's underlying supply or billing grievance
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the dispute and relegated the petitioner to Clause 6.5.
